description.value:
A small flame flickers into being in your hand, harmless to you and your gear, shedding bright light out to 10 feet and dim light 10 feet beyond; it lasts for the duration until you dismiss it as an action or cast the power again.

You may instead hurl the flame at a creature within 30 feet, ending the power in the process—either immediately upon casting or later as an action. Make a ranged tech attack; a hit deals 1d8 fire damage and ignites unattended flammable material nearby.

This power's damage rises to 2d8 at 5th level, 3d8 at 11th level, and 4d8 at 17th level.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, At-Will
